Directions to our Lodge
Drive on the N8 high road from Kimberley to Griekwastad/Campbell and drive for 90 km till you reach a town called Campbell. Drive through the town called Campbell and keep on that road for 5 Km till you reached the Linksfontein Lodge sign on your left hand side, turn left and drive for 6 km on a gravel road till you see the Lodge on your left hand side.

Accommodation Linksfontein Safari Lodge | Northern Cape | South Africa
Linksfontein Safari Lodge | Accommodation | Northern Cape | South Africa
Call us : 0871353405
Mail us : info@linksfonteinsafarilodge.co.za
Accommodation
Whether you are planning a wedding, out of town conference, or just an African holiday experience, Linksfontein Safari Lodge is sure to provide you with an unforgettable experience.
We boast 9 Air-Conditioned Luxury Double Rooms. Stunning lodge facilities and 36 different game animal species to observe, making sure we  guarantee you a luxury holiday experience.
For the more adventurous we provide guests with a range of activities including, game viewing, fishing, hiking, the Big Hole and our historical tours to experience our lodge and heritadge which makes us unique in our own right.
Those wanting a more relaxed holiday can enjoy our luxury Serenity Spa and cuisine by our in-house gourmet chef.
End your day in crisp white Egyptian Cotton linen and enjoy the supremacy of 9 Luxury Air-Conditioned Double Rooms all with spacious en-suite bathrooms.
Each of the 9 luxury en-suite rooms provide:
Aircon
Built-in Cupboards
Mini save for storing valuables
Hot water
Hairdryer
Local and international plugs and adapters
Lodge Facilities include:
A large kitchen with 2 freezers, an ice machine, microwave and 2 big fridges
A large lounge area with DSTV Satelite Television
A large bar and social area with a big fridge, pool table, tables and chairs
A large indoor braai area and dining table
A large dining room which can accommodate up to 30 people at once
Linksfontein Safari Lodge | Northern Cape We offer you luxury accommodation linked to the best safari experience in South Africa.

Linksfontein Safari Lodge Cuisine
Linksfontein Safari Lodge cuisine  something every person likes to have  a nice and tasty dish to eat, and if it looks appealing to, well, then that will definitely put the proverbial cherry on the cake .
Here is one of Linksfontein Safari Lodge Cuisine signature dishes simple and easy to make tasty to eat.
Linksfontein Safari Lodge Venison Kebabs
Our reason for using either Impala or Springbuck meat is the fact that it is a softer kind of meat, meaning it has a finer grain than for example beef.
It is wise to prepare these kebabs and let them marinade for 3 to 4 days, but if need be, it is also good for same day serving given the meat has had a day or 4 to mature. We at Linksfontein Safari Lodge cuisine prefer to let it mature for at least 4 to 7 days.
Ingredients:
2 kg of Impala or Springbuck meat either fillet or buttock cut into cubes
2 Cups of Olive Oil
3 Large Sweet Bell pepper red ,green ,yellow and cut into cubes
375 ml of Greek Salad Dressing Sauce
2 Large Onions peeled and cut into cubes
3 Cups of good natural fat sheep or beef.  (venison tends to have very little to no fat and the sheep or beef fat helps to infuse that fat for a tastier and softer end product)
1 Packet of skewers either wooden or metal
Method:
Start with a cube of meat, then a cube of fat, then a cube of onion and then a cube of pepper.
Use a different colour of pepper each time so that there are 3 colours of peppers on one skewer.
Put into a large bowl or container.
Mix salad dressing and olive oil.
Make sure that all the kebabs are submerged into the sauce.
Put in the fridge to cool down and to marinate.
Remember to remove container from fridge an hour or 2 before grilling or Stop correcting “barbecuing” this helps the meat reach room temperature and thus make for an even distribution of heat.
Serve preferably medium to rare but use own preference as desired
Last but not least .ENJOY!
